description: This PHP source file handles the display of mail scanner rules in the vtiger CRM application. It initializes necessary objects, assigns data to a Smarty template, and renders the MailScannerRule template.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: A class that retrieves and holds information about mail scanner configurations, including rules and settings.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper class used for rendering HTML templates in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getAsMap
methods.description: Returns the mail scanner information as an associative array.
